import React, { useState } from "react"; import { Button, Card, CardHeader, CardBody, FormGroup, Form, Input, Container, Row, Col, Collapse, } from "reactstrap"; import UserHeader from "components/Headers/UserHeader.js"; import firebase from "firebase/app"; import "firebase/database"; const CarbonFootprintInput = () => { const [collapse, setCollapse] = useState({ transportation: false, energy: false, food: false, waste: false, sustainable: false, offset: false, additionalNotes: false, }); const [userData, setUserData] = useState({ carUsageKm: "", vehicleType: "", fuelType: "", publicTransportTrips: "", publicTransportMode: "", flightsPerYear: "", electricityUsage: "", heatingMethod: "", homeSize: "", energyEfficientAppliances: false, dietType: "", meatFrequency: "", recyclingHabit: false, wasteGeneration: "", renewableEnergyUse: false, ecoFriendlyProducts: false, sustainableShopping: false, carbonOffsetProgram: "", carbonOffsetDetails: "", additionalNotes: "", }); const handleChange = (e) => { const { id, value, type, checked } = e.target; setUserData({ ...userData, [id]: type === "checkbox" ? checked : value, }); }; const toggleCollapse = (section) => { setCollapse((prevState) => ({ ...prevState, [section]: !prevState[section], })); }; const handleSubmit = async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); // Check for missing required fields const missingFields = []; for (let field in userData) { if (userData[field] === "" || userData[field] === false) { missingFields.push(field); } } // If there are missing fields, return early and log them (optional) if (missingFields.length > 0) { console.log("Missing fields: ", missingFields); // Optionally, alert the user to complete missing fields return; } // If no fields are missing, log the data console.log("Submitted Data:", userData); // Get the user's ID from Firebase Authentication (assuming user is logged in) const userId = firebase.auth().currentUser.uid; try { // Push the carbon footprint data to Firebase under the user's unique node const userRef = firebase.database().ref(`users/${userId}/userfootprint`); await userRef.set(userData); console.log("Data successfully saved to Firebase"); } catch (error) { console.error("Error saving data to Firebase:", error); } }; return ( <>
